title: Bitget Wallet Arc mainnet support at public launch
notes: First-party Bitget Wallet material published on 2026-09-16 documents Arc public-mainnet support in the existing Bitget Wallet mobile product, including Arc network access, USDC gas, CCTP cross-chain transfers, onchain trading, and dApp access. This bundle records only the material network/product capability change. Referral promotions, launchpad-token performance, and price claims are excluded.

events.title: Bitget Wallet documented Arc mainnet support at public launch
events.description: Bitget Wallet published launch-day guidance for Arc mainnet on 2026-09-16, documenting Arc network support in the self-custodial mobile wallet together with USDC gas, CCTP cross-chain transfers, onchain trading, and access to compatible Arc dApps.
events.notes: The event is scoped to wallet network/product capability. It does not treat Arc token price activity, referral promotions, or third-party launchpad claims as lifecycle evidence.
